import numpy as np
from rcb_hb import Session
import mujoco
from math import sin,cos,atan2,exp,pi
# Parameter coordinates use physical scales; optimizer works in normalized space.
BASE=np.array([1.5,.30,.35,.8,.35,-.4,-.35,0.,0., .10,0., 1.,.12,.2,.03, 1.,.12, .0,.0, .0,.0, .0,.0, .1, .1, .2, .0,.3, .0])
SCALE=np.array([.4,.2,.3,.5,.3,.25,.3,.3,1.5, .15,1.5, .7,.15,.4,.06, .7,.15, .4,.4, .2,.2, .2,.2, .3, .3, .3, 1.,.3, .3])
# freq, hip_amp, knee_amp,knee_base,ankle_comp,hip_base,ankle_base,knee_phase,ankle_phase,
# roll_amp,roll_phase, pitch_kp,pitch_kd,ankle_kp,ankle_kd,roll_kp,roll_kd,
# arm_amp,arm_base,hip_roll_base,yaw_amp,hip_cos,knee_cos, knee_bias, startup,arm_elbow,phase, ramp, ankle_sin
class Controller:
 def __init__(self,s,p):
  self.s=s;self.p=BASE+SCALE*p;self.lo,self.hi=s.model.actuator_ctrlrange.T;self.mid=(self.lo+self.hi)/2;self.half=(self.hi-self.lo)/2
 def action(self,t):
  p=self.p;d=self.s.data
  phase=2*pi*p[0]*t+p[26]
  ramp=min(1,max(0,t/max(.05,abs(p[27]))))
  R=d.xmat[12].reshape(3,3);pitch=atan2(R[0,2],R[2,2]);roll=atan2(-R[1,2],R[2,2])
  pitchfb=p[11]*pitch+p[12]*d.qvel[4]
  rollfb=p[15]*roll+p[16]*d.qvel[3]
  q=np.zeros(19)
  for side,start in enumerate([0,5]):
   ph=phase+side*pi;sn=sin(ph);cs=cos(ph);knee=p[3]+ramp*(p[2]*sin(ph+p[7])+p[22]*cs)+p[23]
   hip=p[5]+ramp*(p[1]*sn+p[21]*cs)+pitchfb
   q[start]=ramp*p[20]*sn
   q[start+1]=rollfb+ramp*p[9]*sin(phase+p[10])+((-1)**side)*p[19]
   q[start+2]=hip
   q[start+3]=knee
   q[start+4]=p[6]-p[4]*(knee-p[3])+ramp*p[28]*sin(ph+p[8])+p[13]*pitch+p[14]*d.qvel[4]
  q[11]=p[18]-p[17]*ramp*sin(phase);q[15]=p[18]+p[17]*ramp*sin(phase)
  q[14]=q[18]=p[25]
  return np.clip((q-self.mid)/self.half,-1,1).astype(np.float32)

def metrics(s):
 d=s.data
 vx=float(d.sensordata[2]);head=float(d.site_xpos[5,2]);up=float(d.xmat[12,8]);eff=float(np.mean(d.actuator_force**2))
 stand=exp(-max(0,1.64-head)**2/.09)*exp(-max(0,1-up)**2/.06)
 speed=exp(-max(0,1.-vx)**2/.45)
 force=.8+.2*exp(-eff/4000)
 return stand*speed*force,vx,head,up,eff

def rollout(s,p,steps=1000,record=False):
 s.reset();c=Controller(s,p);score=0;rows=[];ms=[]
 for i in range(steps):
  a=c.action(i*.02)
  # Direct simulation, exactly the same float32 normalization as Task.step.
  s.data.ctrl[:]=(a+1)/2*(s.low.action_high-s.low.action_low)+s.low.action_low
  mujoco.mj_step(s.model,s.data,nstep=10);mujoco.mj_rnePostConstraint(s.model,s.data)
  m=metrics(s);score+=m[0]
  if record:rows.append(a.copy());ms.append(m)
  if s.data.qpos[2]<.2:break
 return score,np.array(rows),np.array(ms),i+1

if __name__=='__main__':
 s=Session('walk',instance='/app/instance.npz');print(rollout(s,np.zeros(len(BASE)),record=True)[::3])

import numpy as np
class CMAEvolutionStrategy:
 def __init__(self,x,sigma,options):
  self.mean=np.array(x);self.N=len(x);self.sigma=sigma;self.popsize=options['popsize'];self.rng=np.random.default_rng(options['seed']);self.mu=self.popsize//2
  self.w=np.log(self.mu+.5)-np.log(np.arange(1,self.mu+1));self.w/=sum(self.w);self.mueff=1/sum(self.w**2)
  n=self.N;me=self.mueff
  self.cc=(4+me/n)/(n+4+2*me/n);self.cs=(me+2)/(n+me+5);self.c1=2/((n+1.3)**2+me);self.cmu=min(1-self.c1,2*(me-2+1/me)/((n+2)**2+me));self.damps=1+2*max(0,np.sqrt((me-1)/(n+1))-1)+self.cs
  self.pc=np.zeros(n);self.ps=np.zeros(n);self.C=np.eye(n);self.B=np.eye(n);self.D=np.ones(n);self.g=0;self.chi=np.sqrt(n)*(1-1/(4*n)+1/(21*n*n))
 def ask(self):
  self.z=self.rng.normal(size=(self.popsize,self.N));self.y=(self.z*self.D)@self.B.T
  return list(self.mean+self.sigma*self.y)
 def tell(self,x,scores):
  order=np.argsort(scores)[:self.mu];ys=self.y[order];ym=self.w@ys;self.mean+=self.sigma*ym
  invsqrt=(self.B*(1/self.D))@self.B.T
  self.ps=(1-self.cs)*self.ps+np.sqrt(self.cs*(2-self.cs)*self.mueff)*(invsqrt@ym)
  self.g+=1;hs=float(np.linalg.norm(self.ps)/np.sqrt(1-(1-self.cs)**(2*self.g)) < (1.4+2/(self.N+1))*self.chi)
  self.pc=(1-self.cc)*self.pc+hs*np.sqrt(self.cc*(2-self.cc)*self.mueff)*ym
  self.C=(1-self.c1-self.cmu+self.c1*(1-hs)*self.cc*(2-self.cc))*self.C+self.c1*np.outer(self.pc,self.pc)+self.cmu*(ys.T*self.w)@ys
  self.sigma*=np.exp(self.cs/self.damps*(np.linalg.norm(self.ps)/self.chi-1))
